$comment: The weekly scan's web sources — the machine-readable half of what SOURCES.md used to hold in prose tables. Loaded and validated by party-scout-agent/source_registry.py; the method (how to read a site, price-source order, what counts as an event) stays prose in SOURCES.md and party-scanner/SCAN_RULES.md. `id` is stable and is what scan_stats.jsonl records; `aliases` are the free-text names used before the registry existed, so old records still aggregate. `fetch` is the cheapest method known to work; `parser` names a module in party-scanner/ that beats the generic fetch for this source. Instagram handles are a separate list: data/ig_handles.json.

sources.name: Resident Advisor (RA)
sources.notes: `ra_interest.py` queries ra.co/graphql (unauthenticated, NOT Cloudflare-gated) and returns everything a candidate needs in one call: interestedCount/attending (the "rating" heart count), venue address, start/end, cost, blurb, the FLYERFRONT poster from event.images[] (filename = a direct images.ra.co URL that downloads bare) and the artist list. Event HTML is Cloudflare-gated, so render it via `common` only if graphql is missing something. Per-city listing URLs are their own entries (ra-san-francisco, ra-los-angeles).

sources.name: Tixr
sources.notes: DataDome-protected, so a bare fetch fails: one ephemeral remote-browser fetch (real Chrome passes it), then read the page's schema.org JSON-LD in one shot — flyer (static.tixr.com, downloads bare), ALL price tiers, venue/time/age. Exclude add-on tiers (parking, coat check) from the price range. No parser is deployed: the old tixr.py lived in the deleted party-scout-code repo and does not exist anywhere now.

sources.name: Eventbrite
sources.notes: `eb_demand.py` reads offers.lowPrice/highPrice plus availability/salesStatus (SoldOut is the strongest demand flag) from the page's schema.org JSON-LD. Per-city discovery feeds are their own entries.

sources.name: Dice
sources.notes: Price lives in the JS app, so it needs a render.

sources.name: AXS
sources.notes: Venue box offices (e.g. thefoxoakland.com, the Regency) hand off here. The price sits in a Buy-Tickets widget/iframe — open/expand it, don't just scrape the page body.

sources.name: Ticketmaster / Live Nation
sources.notes: Same shape as AXS: the tiers are in the buy widget, not the page body.

sources.name: TicketWeb
sources.notes: JS-rendered (a bare fetch returns a ~10KB shell), so one ephemeral remote-browser fetch, then read the page's schema.org Event JSON-LD in one shot — flyer (i.ticketweb.com, downloads bare), venue + full address, start, price. Its price is the ONLINE TOTAL INCL. FEE, so the door price on the flyer may be lower. No parser is deployed: the old ticketweb.py lived in the deleted party-scout-code repo.

sources.name: See Tickets
sources.notes: One of the misc ticketers the 19hz / RA rows link out to.

sources.name: Posh
sources.notes: One of the misc ticketers the 19hz / RA rows link out to; also the bio link for some DJ handles.

sources.name: Etix
sources.notes: One of the misc ticketers the 19hz / RA rows link out to.

sources.name: Meetup
sources.notes: Rides, runs and club meets. Default to Free unless the event page states a fee.

sources.name: RunGuides
sources.notes: National race calendar — filter by city.

sources.name: RunningInTheUSA
sources.notes: National race calendar — filter by city.

sources.name: Strava clubs
sources.notes: Local moto / cycling / run clubs — filter by city.

sources.name: 19hz (Bay Area)
sources.notes: THE anchor source for SF. Chronological, carries a price column, and every row links out to its ticketer — try the price here first. The listing itself is an aggregator index, so it never goes into an event's `sources` (REQUIREMENTS rules 8-11).

sources.name: Resident Advisor — San Francisco
sources.notes: The SF listing URL; extraction is the shared `resident-advisor` entry.

sources.name: EDMtrain — San Francisco
sources.notes: Good listing, sparse pricing.

sources.name: Eventbrite — San Francisco discovery
sources.notes: SF discovery feed; price via the shared `eventbrite` entry.

sources.name: Do415
sources.notes: SF happenings.

sources.name: Funcheap SF
sources.notes: Free events. The best single source for the free/outdoor/daytime open-airs the owner especially wants (party-scanner/README.md, Liked-style boost).

sources.name: SF Bike Coalition
sources.notes: Group rides, Critical Mass.

sources.name: Halcyon
sources.notes: SoMa club (314 11th St). Full upcoming-events + ticket listing; each event links out to its ticketer, mostly Dice.

sources.name: The Regency Ballroom
sources.notes: 1300 Van Ness. /shows is the upcoming calendar; links out to AXS/Ticketmaster for price.

sources.name: 1015 Folsom
sources.notes: SoMa mega-club (1015 Folsom St): big-room EDM/house/techno/bass. The homepage renders the whole upcoming-shows calendar in plain HTML — cheapest venue source we have. Each show links out to its ticketer, mostly RA, some Dice.

sources.name: The Midway
sources.notes: Dogpatch warehouse (900 Marin St): EDM/house/techno/bass plus big DAY PARTIES. /Events/ is the upcoming calendar. Cloudflare-gated, so render via `common`. Links out to AXS / Eventbrite / box office.

sources.name: Cat Club
sources.notes: SoMa club (1190 Folsom St), two floors — the SF goth/darkwave/synth/industrial/80s hub, with recurring nights (NIGHTSHIFT, 1984, …). Calendar on the site; mostly door cover, some ticketed.

sources.name: Stern Grove Festival
sources.notes: DO NOT SCAN and do not auto-add its concerts. It is an annual, once-a-year festival series, not the recurring nightlife/party scene Party Scout tracks. Stern Grove events already in the DB stay — this is about not scanning the site for more.

sources.name: 19hz (Los Angeles)
sources.notes: THE anchor source for LA. Chronological, price column, rows link out to the ticketer. Its "Los Angeles" listing spans all of SoCal, so check each row is really LA — San Diego promoters that surfaced here are parked as `documented` entries, not filed as LA.

sources.name: Resident Advisor — Los Angeles
sources.notes: The LA listing URL (RA area 23); extraction is the shared `resident-advisor` entry.

sources.name: EDMtrain — Los Angeles
sources.notes: Listing, sparse pricing.

sources.name: Eventbrite — Los Angeles discovery
sources.notes: LA discovery feed; price via the shared `eventbrite` entry.

sources.name: Funcheap LA
sources.notes: Free/outdoor events.

sources.name: Insomniac Events
sources.notes: Site-verified LA: HARD Summer, Lost In Dreams, Factory 93 / Day Trip (it also runs national events, so check the city per event). Browse the site for the calendar; each event links out to its ticketer for price. IG @insomniacevents (942k) — see data/ig_handles.json.

sources.name: Brownies & Lemonade
sources.notes: Site-verified LA-based: Shrine / The Roxy / warehouse parties, plus national takeovers. IG @browniesandlemonade (201k).

sources.name: Goldenvoice
sources.notes: Site-verified LA — AEG's LA arm: Greek Theatre, The Novo, El Rey, Shrine, Roxy. IG @goldenvoice (149k).

sources.name: Restless Nites
sources.notes: Site-verified LA — an LA nightlife guide/ticketing site with an LA city selector. IG @restlessnites (29k).

sources.name: Minimal Effort (Underrated Presents)
sources.notes: Site-verified LA — Underrated Presents, Arts District warehouse techno. IG @minimaleffortla (21k).

sources.name: Subtract Music
sources.notes: Site-verified LA metro — "Subtract On The Pier" and Love Long Beach Festival, both in Long Beach rather than LA proper. IG @subtractmusic (13k).

sources.name: This Ain't Bristol
sources.notes: LA-associated bass/house label and party. The link is music-heavy rather than a calendar — confirm the venues at scan time. IG @thisaintbristol (13k).

sources.name: Azure Day Party SoCal
sources.notes: Orange County, not LA proper — every event is at The Bungalow, Huntington Beach. Greater-LA-ish, so kept, but label it honestly. IG @azuredaypartysocal (7k).

sources.name: FNGRS CRSSD
sources.notes: CRSSD Festival at Waterfront Park + Proper; house/techno, all San Diego. PARKED, not scanned: it surfaced on the 19hz "Los Angeles" listing (which spans SoCal) but there is no san-diego city in the site yet, so its events have no city to be filed into. RA agrees SD is its own region (ra.co/events/us/sandiego, area 309, separate from LA area 23). Do NOT scout it into LA or SF. IG @fngrscrssd (79k).

sources.name: LED Presents
sources.notes: Big-room EDM/bass; the calendar is all San Diego venues (Spin, EQ, Quartyard, Gallagher Sq). PARKED for the same reason as fngrs-crssd — no san-diego city exists yet. IG @ledpresents (74k).
